subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers be denied patch access to every legacy ownerless session row, or must OpenClaw provide an explicit migration or owner-claim path first?
rationale: This choice defines the persisted-session upgrade and recovery contract at a cross-plugin authorization boundary; tests can prove implementation behavior but cannot establish maintainer intent for existing ownerless data.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Reject ownerless rows and document a non-plugin operator recovery path for affected sessions.

options.title: Migrate ownership first
options.body: Add a doctor or explicitly owner-authorized migration before enforcing the denial.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows and document a non-plugin operator recovery path for affected sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current session ownership and projection behavior in the central merged lifecycle work.
